'''Lorul''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Nautolan/Legends|Nautolan]] [[Private/Legends|Private]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] living during the [[Galactic War]]. During the [[Invasion of Belsavis]] around [[3641 BBY]] she was stationed in the [[High Security Section]] on [[Belsavis/Legends|Belsavis]] when the Empire provoken poisonous local fauna into attacking Republic forces. [[Sergeant/Legends|Sergeant]] [[Kayen]] developed an antidote against the poison, which required the gland samples from the creatures to work, and asked a Republic operative in the area to gather the glands and deliver them to Private Lorul.<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Private Lorul appears in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' as an NPC on Belsavis, who starts the mission "Emergent Medicine."
